description:
Show the current website offers as an interactive card with photos and links.

Use instead of get_offers when the guest wants to browse the offers visually. Same behaviour (read-only)
and result as get_offers, plus a photo per offer.

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
